fig38_short_en: Identity mixing and bounded read-write maps do not explain mHC's full cost. In Hyper-Connections, identity mixing raises cost most, shared write keeps it close, and clipped AttnRes queries spike.
fig38_short_zh: 单位混合和有界读写解释不了 mHC 的全部代价。Hyper-Connections 中单位混合让代价升得最高，共用写入则代价相近。裁剪 query 的 AttnRes 仍有尖峰。
fig38_insert_en: Hyper-Connections with its mixing fixed to the identity pays 0.169 nats, the largest cost of any 48-layer design we trained. Figure 50 splits this cost into its two models. The learned mixing of the ordinary Hyper-Connections model shrinks the stream sum in the early layers, to about half per layer over layers 2-11, whereas identity and Sinkhorn mixing leave the sum unchanged. Three more Hyper-Connections variants are still training. Their bars are empty. In the first, the dynamic parts of read and write come from one joint projection of all streams, as in mHC. In the second, the mixing keeps the stream sum, because each stream's outgoing weights add up to one. In the third, the mixing is one learned number per sublayer, which scales the whole state and moves nothing between streams. The last two test whether the effect of the mixing on the stream sum is what matters.
fig38_insert_zh: 固定为单位混合的 Hyper-Connections 代价是 0.169 nats，在我们训练的所有 48 层结构中代价最大。图 50 把这一代价拆成对应的两个模型。普通 Hyper-Connections 模型学到的混合在浅层会缩小各流之和，在第 2-11 层每层缩小到约一半，而单位混合与 Sinkhorn 混合都保持各流之和不变。另外三个 Hyper-Connections 变体仍在训练。它们的柱子目前为空。在第一个变体中，读取和写入的动态部分像 mHC 一样来自所有流的同一个联合投影。在第二个变体中，混合保持各流之和不变，因为每条流向外的权重相加为一。在第三个变体中，每个子层的混合是单个可学习标量，只缩放整个状态而不在流之间传递。最后两个变体检验混合对各流之和的影响是不是关键。
fig50_short_en: Every mHC ordinary model beats every Hyper-Connections one. With identity mixing, the ordinary model of Hyper-Connections is close to mHC's, and its separate-heads model has the highest loss here.
fig50_short_zh: 所有 mHC 普通模型都优于 Hyper-Connections 普通模型。改用单位混合后，Hyper-Connections 普通模型接近 mHC，独立头模型在图中损失最高。
fig50_insert_en: Fixing the mixing of Hyper-Connections to the identity tests whether the learned mixing separates its ordinary model from mHC's. All numbers here are on the newer code. The ordinary model falls from 2.956 to 2.931 nats, below every Hyper-Connections model with learned mixing and above every mHC model. Its evaluation loss reaches mHC's level, at 3.579 nats against 3.576 for mHC with identity mixing and linear read and write, and 3.638 for Hyper-Connections. The probes change far more than the last layer. At layers 10-32 they end 1.03-1.23 nats above Hyper-Connections, and at layers 12-48 they stay within 0.23 nats of that mHC design. The separate-heads model moves the other way and rises from 3.003 to 3.100 nats, the highest in this figure. The cost rises from 0.047 to 0.169 nats. The separate-heads gap to Hyper-Connections stays near 0.02 nats until about step 2,750 of 4,959, and then grows while the gradients of the first three layers grow. At the final checkpoint, about 3% of the tokens have a state more than 100 times the median. For most of them this starts with one MLP write at layer 5, about 10^5 times the median write, and identity mixing keeps it through every later layer. These tokens account for about a fifth of the rise on 4,096 tokens of held-out text. We have not yet found the source of the rest.
fig50_insert_zh: 把 Hyper-Connections 的混合固定为单位混合，用来检验学到的混合是否拉开了它的普通模型与 mHC 普通模型的差距。这里的数值都来自新代码。普通模型从 2.956 降到 2.931 nats，低于所有学到混合的 Hyper-Connections 模型，高于所有 mHC 模型。它的评估损失达到 mHC 的水平，为 3.579 nats，而单位混合加线性读取和写入的 mHC 为 3.576，Hyper-Connections 为 3.638。探针的变化远大于最后一层。在第 10-32 层，探针最终比 Hyper-Connections 高 1.03-1.23 nats，在第 12-48 层则与该 mHC 结构的差距保持在 0.23 nats 以内。独立头模型向反方向变化，从 3.003 升到 3.100 nats，为本图最高。代价从 0.047 升到 0.169 nats。独立头模型与 Hyper-Connections 的差距在 4,959 步中的约第 2,750 步之前一直接近 0.02 nats，随后在前三层梯度变大的同时扩大。在最终检查点，约 3% 的 token 的状态超过中位数的 100 倍。对其中大多数 token，这始于第 5 层一次约为写入中位数 10^5 倍的 MLP 写入，而单位混合把这一写入一直保留到后续每一层。在 4,096 个留出文本 token 上，这些 token 占了损失上升的约五分之一。我们还没有找到其余部分的来源。
